name: 1643-library-fault
about: guard-lib-user's after hook on MR::getRandom calls guard-lib's gl.fine (7), then gl.fault, which writes through a null pointer in guard-lib's code: caught at guard-lib-user's boundary like a fault in its own code, guard-lib-user off and taken out at the next frame, GUARD in the log naming a library mod's code, the game goes on; guard-lib stays and guard-lib-other's call of gl.fine after it gives 7

expect.log: \[mod guard-lib-user\] GUARD: its code failed \(after hook: MR::getRandom\): a memory access it may not make at a library mod's code 0x[0-9a-f]+, address 0x[0-9a-f]+\. It is off until the next start; what it was changing may be half done\.
